rationale: The Latin anchors *transcribere*, *describere*, and *conscribere* all point to the act of copying/writing out text, and the phrase *cuncta per ordinem transcribere curavi* ("I took care to transcribe everything in order") confirms a scribal copying sense. *contexere* ("to compose/weave together in writing") further reinforces written textual reproduction. This matches transcribe.v.01 ("write out from speech, notes, etc."), the only candidate dealing with the literal act of writing/copying text, as opposed to musical arrangement, phonetic notation, or genetic processes.
